description: This file implements the instructor's course detail page in a Next.js React application, including course editing, module and chapter management, quiz creation, assessment placeholders, and publishing logic.

methods.name: getContentIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon component based on the content type.

methods.name: handleContentReorder
methods.description: Reorders content items within a module after drag-and-drop.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a new module to the course modules list.

methods.name: addChapter
methods.description: Adds a new chapter/content item to a specified module.

methods.name: updateModuleTitle
methods.description: Updates the title of a specified module.

methods.name: updateChapter
methods.description: Updates properties of a specific chapter within a module.

methods.name: deleteChapter
methods.description: Removes a chapter/content item from a module.

methods.name: toggleChapterPublished
methods.description: Toggles the published state of a chapter.

methods.name: fetchCourseQuizAttempts
methods.description: Fetches quiz attempts for the course periodically.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves course details, modules, and assessments; syncs with backend.

methods.name: handlePublish
methods.description: Publishes the course; syncs data with backend, creates course if necessary, updates status.
